meta.question:
Godot 4.2.2: Area3D cant collide with CSGBoxes or StaticBodies

I am currently trying my hand at a 3D ARPG in Godot 4.2.1 (and 4.2.2) and have a problem with collision detection. The collision between my projectile (Area3D with CollisionShape3D) collides with an enemy (CharacterBody3D) as expected, but not with instances of StaticBody3D or CSGBox3D.
Setup:

Collision Layer and Mask on Projectile and all Targets set to 1
body entered and area entered signals on the projectile are connected to respective functions in the script projectiles script
Monitoring is enabled

I am wondering if the problem is that the projectile is an Area3D? Or am I missing something obvious?
Thanks in advance.
What i tried:

changing collision layers and masks
changing the speed of the projectile to a stupendously low value
changing the root node of the projectile to a RigidBody3D (resulted in no collision at all, not even with the enemy

answers:
I found out what the problem is: I was using jolt. When switching back to the default physic engine, everything works like a charm.
Jolt seems to be broken in other areas at the moment (at least for 4.2.1 and 4.2.2), or I just dont handle it right. Another big issue is, that the game just crashes without any hint, when there are runtime error in my scripts. Since I only just started with GDScript, that happened a few times and left me baffled...

nuggets.text: The collision detection issue is caused by using the Jolt physics engine in Godot 4.2.1 and 4.2.2.
Switching to the default physics engine resolves the collision detection problem.

Page 1 identifies two relevant caveats:
- Areas and bodies created with PhysicsServer3D may not interact correctly with Area3D or emit signals reliably.
- A ConcavePolygonShape3D inside an Area3D’s CollisionShape3D is hollow and can produce unexpected results. Suggested alternatives include multiple ConvexPolygonShape3Ds or primitive shapes such as BoxShape3D.

For instantaneous overlap detection, page 1 also describes shape casting with `target_position = Vector3(0, 0, 0)` and `force_shapecast_update()` in the same physics frame, because Area3D collision information is not immediately available.

Are the undetected targets created through PhysicsServer3D, and what collision shape does your projectile use?","citations":["第1页"]}

I am currently trying my hand at a 3D ARPG in Godot 4.2.1 (and 4.2.2) and have a problem with collision detection. The collision between my projectile (Area3D with CollisionShape3D) collides with an enemy (CharacterBody3D) as expected, but not with instances of StaticBody3D or CSGBox3D.
Setup:

Collision Layer and Mask on Projectile and all Targets set to 1
body entered and area entered signals on the projectile are connected to respective functions in the script projectiles script
Monitoring is enabled

I am wondering if the problem is that the projectile is an Area3D? Or am I missing something obvious?
Thanks in advance.
What i tried:

changing collision layers and masks
changing the speed of the projectile to a stupendously low value
changing the root node of the projectile to a RigidBody3D (resulted in no collision at all, not even with the enemy

evidence.text: For performance reasons (collisions are all processed at the same time) this list is modified once during the physics step, not immediately after objects are moved. Consider using signals instead.
